domain-information: A collection manager reviews upcoming collection route schedules containing collection routes.
A collection manager monitors route logs to identify delays or missed pickups.
A collection manager coordinates with the maintenance supervisor to ensure vehicles assigned to routes are operational.
A client makes a request for a pickup at a specific location.
A route planner assigns waste trucks to optimized routes based on collection zones and vehicle capacity.
A route planner updates the route when clients change pickup locations.
A route planner reviews traffic data to adjust routes for efficiency.
A driver checks the assigned truck and verifies the route plan before leaving the depot.
A driver records the volume and type of waste collected at each stop in the route log.
A driver reports any access issues or hazardous materials found during collection to the route planner.
A driver checks in at the sorting facility to load off the collected waste.
A recycling coordinator inspects incoming waste loads at the sorting facility to ensure proper separation.
A recycling coordinator reports contamination issues in recyclable materials to the collection manager.
A recycling coordinator organizes the transfer of sorted materials to partner recycling plants.
A maintenance supervisor conducts preventive maintenance for trucks.
A maintenance supervisor updates maintenance records after completing repairs or servicing vehicles.
A maintenance supervisor informs the collection manager when a truck is unavailable due to repair needs.

domain objects.name: Collection Manager
domain objects.description: Oversees waste collection operations and monitors performance.

domain objects.name: Route Schedule
domain objects.description: Plan outlining upcoming collection routes and their timing.

domain objects.name: Collection Route
domain objects.description: Defined path for waste collection including stops and assigned truck.

domain objects.name: Waste Truck
domain objects.description: Vehicle used for waste collection, linked to capacity, zone, and driver.

domain objects.name: Collection Zone
domain objects.description: Geographical area covered by one or more collection routes.

domain objects.name: Vehicle Capacity
domain objects.description: Maximum volume of waste a truck can carry on a route.

domain objects.name: Driver
domain objects.description: Operates waste trucks and logs collection data during routes.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Records
domain objects.description: Logs and documentation of maintenance performed on vehicles.

domain objects.name: Traffic Data
domain objects.description: Information about current road and traffic conditions used for planning.

domain objects.name: Route Log
domain objects.description: Record of collected waste volumes, stops, and incidents during a route.

domain objects.name: Pickup Location
domain objects.description: Client site where waste is collected during a route.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Supervisor
domain objects.description: Responsible for scheduling and overseeing vehicle maintenance.

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: Requests pickup services from the waste management company.

domain objects.name: Pickup Request
domain objects.description: Client request for waste collection at a specific location.

domain objects.name: Route Planner
domain objects.description: Designs and adjusts collection routes for efficiency and coverage.

domain objects.name: Issue Report
domain objects.description: Report created by drivers describing route issues or incidents.

domain objects.name: Recycling Coordinator
domain objects.description: Manages sorting operations and the transfer of recyclable materials.

domain objects.name: Sorting Facility
domain objects.description: Facility where collected waste is separated for recycling or disposal.

domain objects.name: Contamination Issue
domain objects.description: Problem caused by mixing recyclable and non-recyclable materials.

domain objects.name: Material Transfer
domain objects.description: Process of sending sorted materials to recycling partners.

domain objects.name: Partner Recycling Plant
domain objects.description: External plant that receives and processes sorted recyclable materials.

domain objects.name: Preventive Maintenance
domain objects.description: Scheduled servicing of vehicles to prevent breakdowns.

associations.description: Collection Manager reviews Route Schedule to plan operations.
Collection Manager coordinates with Maintenance Supervisor to ensure vehicle readiness.
Client submits Pickup Request to schedule a waste collection.
Route Planner processes Pickup Request to assign it to a route.
Route Planner analyzes Traffic Data to optimize route efficiency.
Route Planner defines and updates Collection Route details.
Route Planner assigns Waste Truck to a Collection Route.
Driver executes assigned Collection Route and records data.
Driver submits Issue Report to document problems during collection.
Issue Report is reviewed by Route Planner to address operational issues.
Driver delivers collected waste to the Sorting Facility for processing.
Maintenance Supervisor schedules Preventive Maintenance tasks.
Preventive Maintenance keeps Waste Truck operational and reliable.
Maintenance Supervisor updates Maintenance Records after servicing.
Recycling Coordinator manages sorting processes at the Sorting Facility.
Recycling Coordinator identifies and reports Contamination Issues in waste loads.
Contamination Issue is reported to Collection Manager for review and action.
Recycling Coordinator oversees Material Transfer of sorted materials.
Material Transfer delivers recyclable materials to Partner Recycling Plant.
